ConocoPhillips was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.

As of June 30, 2026, we had operations and activities in 15 countries.

We manage our operations through six operating segments defined by geographic area: Lower 48; Europe, Middle East and North Africa; Asia Pacific; Alaska; Canada; and Other International. ConocoPhillips’ operating segments include a strong base of legacy production, multiple ongoing development programs that offer low cost of supply and low-carbon intensity, along with focused exploration opportunities.
